name: Moto
source:
A clone of Emoto, a classmate of [url=https://vndb.org/c113716]Minato Kohichi[/url] who was killed by Kohichi. A bionoid with no combat ability that was partially recovered by Dr. Bakuroi after he was killed.

It was [url=https://vndb.org/c113724]Haruna[/url] who invested in the research and production funds, and after the completion, he was taken in by him as well. They have an uncle-nephew bond, although Moto also acts as his assistant and housekeeper. He doesn't have many emotional ups and downs, and his motor nerves are a little dull.

[Translated from [url=https://saya-sp.com/hanasaya_gp_op/layer_if/layer_ifb_character/]official website[/url]]
